title: monarda punctata subsp. stanfieldii
intro: Monarda punctata subsp. stanfieldii, commonly known as spotted beebalm or prairie bergamot, is a perennial plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects that contribute to its use in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Monarda punctata subsp. stanfieldii include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, thanks to its therapeutic actions as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and antipyretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include monoterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in herbal remedies and traditional medicine.
